note: Chenango County park (Greene) on an 18-acre pond with a boat launch (trolling motors only) and kayak and paddleboat rentals; home to both seasonal and weekend campers. Some sites tight/sloped. --Claude
summary: County page and its 2026-2029 rate sheet confirm 40 sites with water and 20/30 A electric, showers, dump, Memorial Day - Columbus Day season, camper site $50 (2026) / $55 (2027; fees left as recorded 2026-10-11), cash or check, no refunds, phone 607-656-8752 (park office 607-244-1912). Neither page says how campsites are reserved, so booking (derived: phone) is left. Note: dropped site/hookup/facility/season restatements and the 'RV Life unrated' line.
flags: Possible mostly-seasonal park: the rate sheet leads with seasonal sites (waterfront and interior water/30-amp, lean-tos, a 50-amp site) plus monthly and weekly rates, and the history says the park 'has been home to both seasonal and week-end campers'. Nightly camper sites are posted ($50 in 2026), but no page gives how many of the 40 are nightly. Not a price-gate case (county park).
